quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Identical Twins] Even though the twins are wearing identical outfits today, only one of them raises a hand when the teacher asks who forgot their lunch.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the other twin?
options: Both twins forgot their lunch.
That twin remembered to bring lunch.
The teacher packed lunch for both twins.
Neither twin has lunch today.
quests.correctAnswer: That twin remembered to bring lunch.
quests.hint: Think about what it means that only one hand goes up in response to the question.
quests.explanation: Since only one twin raises a hand about forgetting lunch, the other twin must have remembered to bring theirs.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [The Clearance Rack] The clearance rack is pushed to the very back of the store, while the newest arrivals are displayed right by the entrance under bright lights.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the store's priorities?
options: It has removed the clearance items from sale.
It wants customers to notice the new arrivals first.
It wants customers to avoid the new arrivals.
It treats every item with equal importance.
quests.correctAnswer: It wants customers to notice the new arrivals first.
quests.hint: Think about why certain items are placed in the most visible spot near the entrance.
quests.explanation: Placing new arrivals under bright lights by the entrance, while pushing clearance items back, suggests the store wants shoppers to see the newer items first.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [After the Merger] After the merger, half of the staff receive new title cards for their desks, while the other half are told to wait for further announcements.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the staff without new title cards?
options: They were all immediately promoted.
They were all let go from the company.
Their roles have not yet been decided.
Their titles were finalized before everyone else's.
quests.correctAnswer: Their roles have not yet been decided.
quests.hint: Think about what 'wait for further announcements' suggests about their situation.
quests.explanation: Being told to wait for more information, while others already have new titles, suggests those employees' roles are still undecided.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [New Medication] Since starting his new medication, Mr. Ibrahim's headaches have become far less frequent, though he still feels a little tired in the mornings.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the medication?
options: It has fixed every symptom he had.
It has made all of his symptoms worse.
It has had no effect on him whatsoever.
It has partially, but not completely, solved his problem.
quests.correctAnswer: It has partially, but not completely, solved his problem.
quests.hint: Notice that one symptom improved while another one remains.
quests.explanation: Fewer headaches but continued morning tiredness suggests the medication helped with one issue while another still lingers.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Broken-Down Bus] The tour group's bus breaks down on a quiet country road, and the guide begins calling several numbers while checking a paper map.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the guide's plan?
options: She is trying to arrange another way to continue the tour.
She already fixed the bus herself.
She has decided to end the tour immediately.
She is calling to book a different vacation.
quests.correctAnswer: She is trying to arrange another way to continue the tour.
quests.hint: Think about why someone would make several calls and check a map after a breakdown.
quests.explanation: Making calls and checking a map after the breakdown suggests the guide is working out a new way to keep the tour moving.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Streaming Recommendations] The streaming service recommends three cooking shows in a row, all similar to the baking competition Tom finished watching last night.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the streaming service's recommendations?
options: They are chosen completely at random.
They are the same for every user of the service.
They are based on what Tom recently watched.
They ignore Tom's viewing history entirely.
quests.correctAnswer: They are based on what Tom recently watched.
quests.hint: Think about the connection between the new suggestions and what Tom watched last night.
quests.explanation: Recommending similar cooking shows right after Tom finished a baking competition suggests the suggestions are shaped by his viewing history.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Popular Graphic Novel] The librarian orders ten additional copies of the same graphic novel after the current three copies stay checked out for the entire semester.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the graphic novel?
options: It was removed from the library.
It is only available to teachers.
It is in high demand among students.
It sits unread on the shelves.
quests.correctAnswer: It is in high demand among students.
quests.hint: Think about what constantly checked-out copies would lead a librarian to do.
quests.explanation: Ordering ten more copies after the originals stayed checked out all semester suggests the graphic novel is very popular with students.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [An Extra Rehearsal] The orchestra adds an extra rehearsal the week before the show after the conductor stops the music twice during the same difficult section.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the difficult section of music?
options: It is the easiest part of the piece.
It has already been perfected by the orchestra.
It still needs more practice before the performance.
It was removed from the performance.
quests.correctAnswer: It still needs more practice before the performance.
quests.hint: Think about why a conductor would stop the music at the same spot more than once.
quests.explanation: Stopping the music twice at the same section, followed by an extra rehearsal, suggests that part still needs more work.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Growing Waiting List] The community garden's waiting list grows to thirty names after the local news features a story about its fresh vegetables and flowers.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the news story's effect?
options: It resulted in the garden closing.
It had no effect on the waiting list.
It increased interest in joining the garden.
It caused people to leave the garden project.
quests.correctAnswer: It increased interest in joining the garden.
quests.hint: Think about what happened to the waiting list right after the story aired.
quests.explanation: A waiting list growing to thirty names right after the story suggests the coverage sparked more interest in the garden.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Less Sugar] The recipe calls for two cups of sugar, but Aunt Bea quietly reduces it to half a cup, mentioning that her sister prefers less sweet desserts.
quests.question: What can be inferred about Aunt Bea's changes to the recipe?
options: She adjusted it based on her sister's taste.
She dislikes sugar in every dessert.
She is following the recipe exactly as written.
She forgot how much sugar the recipe needed.
quests.correctAnswer: She adjusted it based on her sister's taste.
quests.hint: Think about the reason Aunt Bea gives right after describing the change.
quests.explanation: Mentioning her sister's preference for less sweetness right after reducing the sugar shows the change was made specifically for her.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [The Same Teddy Bear] Every family photo on the wall shows the children at different ages, but the same worn teddy bear appears tucked under someone's arm in each one.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the teddy bear?
options: Each child owned a different teddy bear.
It appears in only one of the photos.
It was purchased just last week.
It has been an important item to the family for a long time.
quests.correctAnswer: It has been an important item to the family for a long time.
quests.hint: Think about what it means for the same object to appear across photos taken years apart.
quests.explanation: The same teddy bear appearing in photos from different ages suggests it has been meaningful to the family for a long time.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Secret Coupon] The store clerk quietly slips an extra coupon into Mrs. Alden's bag after noticing her carefully recount her cash at the register.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the clerk's action?
options: The clerk made a mistake by accident.
The clerk wanted to help her save some money.
The clerk wanted her to spend more money.
The clerk was following store policy for every customer.
quests.correctAnswer: The clerk wanted to help her save some money.
quests.hint: Think about why the clerk would act right after seeing her count her cash carefully.
quests.explanation: Slipping in a coupon right after noticing her careful counting suggests the clerk was trying to help her save money.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Three Different Answers] The new hire asks three coworkers the same question about the printer within an hour, and each gives a slightly different answer.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the printer instructions?
options: The new hire already knew the answer.
They are written perfectly and understood by all.
They are not clearly understood by the staff.
No one in the office has ever used the printer.
quests.correctAnswer: They are not clearly understood by the staff.
quests.hint: Think about what different answers to the same question suggest about shared understanding.
quests.explanation: Getting three different answers to one simple question suggests the printer instructions are not clearly understood, even by experienced staff.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Feeling Rested] After two weeks of eating dinner earlier and avoiding screens before bed, Mei tells her sister that she finally feels rested when she wakes up.
quests.question: What can be inferred about Mei's new evening habits?
options: They had no connection to her sleep.
They caused her to wake up earlier only.
They appear to have improved her sleep.
They made her sleep much worse.
quests.correctAnswer: They appear to have improved her sleep.
quests.hint: Think about what changed in her routine right before she started feeling rested.
quests.explanation: Feeling rested after changing her evening habits suggests those changes helped improve her sleep quality.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Free Upgrade] The airline moves Grace to seat 2A without charge and mentions it is thanking her for her patience after last month's cancelled flight.
quests.question: What can be inferred about Grace's previous experience with the airline?
options: She was likely inconvenienced by a cancelled flight before.
She requested the free upgrade herself.
She caused the flight to be cancelled.
She has never flown with this airline before.
quests.correctAnswer: She was likely inconvenienced by a cancelled flight before.
quests.hint: Think about what the airline's comment about 'last month's cancelled flight' reveals.
quests.explanation: Thanking Grace for her patience about a cancelled flight last month shows she experienced that disruption previously.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Confused Speaker] The smart speaker mishears Ana's request three times in a row, playing the wrong song each time before finally getting it right.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the smart speaker?
options: It was intentionally programmed to play the wrong songs.
It is not capable of playing music at all.
It sometimes struggles to understand voice commands accurately.
It understands every command perfectly.
quests.correctAnswer: It sometimes struggles to understand voice commands accurately.
quests.hint: Think about what happening three times in a row before success suggests about accuracy.
quests.explanation: Mishearing the request three times before getting it right suggests the speaker has some difficulty understanding voice commands correctly.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Lower Score] Critics give the sequel lower scores than the original film, though several mention that the visual effects are even more impressive this time.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the sequel?
options: It was rated higher than the original in every way.
Critics agreed it was flawless.
It improved in some ways but not in overall quality.
It had worse visual effects than the original.
quests.correctAnswer: It improved in some ways but not in overall quality.
quests.hint: Notice which part improved and which part received a lower score.
quests.explanation: Lower overall scores combined with praise for better effects suggest the sequel improved visually but fell short in other ways.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Struggling Succulent] Every plant on Wen's balcony grows a little taller each week, except for the one succulent she moved to the shadiest corner last month.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the succulent in the shady corner?
options: It may not be getting enough light to grow well.
It requires no sunlight at all to thrive.
It is growing faster than the other plants.
It was already fully grown before being moved.
quests.correctAnswer: It may not be getting enough light to grow well.
quests.hint: Compare the succulent's growth with the other plants, and think about what changed for it.
quests.explanation: The succulent's lack of growth after being moved to a shadier spot suggests it may not be getting the light it needs.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Last Year's Top Toy] The toy that was the top request on every child's holiday list last year now sits untouched on store shelves this season.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the toy's popularity?
options: It sold out completely this season.
It was never popular at any point.
It has grown even more popular.
It has declined since last year.
quests.correctAnswer: It has declined since last year.
quests.hint: Compare how in-demand the toy was last year with how it appears now.
quests.explanation: A once highly requested toy now sitting untouched suggests its popularity has dropped compared to last year.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [One More Time] Dad reads the same bedtime story every night in a different silly voice, and Leo always asks for 'one more time' before finally falling asleep.
quests.question: What can be inferred about Leo's feelings toward the bedtime story?
options: He genuinely enjoys the story and the routine.
He falls asleep before the story begins.
He prefers reading the story by himself.
He is tired of hearing the same story.
quests.correctAnswer: He genuinely enjoys the story and the routine.
quests.hint: Think about what asking for 'one more time' reveals about how much he enjoys it.
quests.explanation: Asking for 'one more time' every night shows that Leo genuinely looks forward to and enjoys this bedtime routine.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Popular Elective] The school adds a second science lab and hires another teacher after enrollment in the science elective doubles over two years.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the science elective?
options: More students have been choosing to take it.
The elective was removed from the schedule.
The school reduced its science offerings.
Fewer students are interested in science.
quests.correctAnswer: More students have been choosing to take it.
quests.hint: Think about what a growing need for space and staff suggests about student interest.
quests.explanation: Adding a lab and a teacher because enrollment doubled suggests more students have been signing up for the science elective.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Adjustable Desks] Since the office installed adjustable desks, fewer employees visit the on-site clinic complaining about neck and shoulder pain.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the adjustable desks?
options: They caused more visits to the clinic.
They were removed shortly after installation.
They had no effect on employee comfort.
They may have reduced physical strain for employees.
quests.correctAnswer: They may have reduced physical strain for employees.
quests.hint: Think about what fewer clinic visits, right after the desks were installed, suggests.
quests.explanation: A drop in clinic visits for neck and shoulder pain after the new desks arrived suggests the desks helped reduce physical strain.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Record Month] The volunteer coordinator sends a thank-you email listing the number of meals served this month, a total higher than any previous month on record.
quests.question: What can be inferred about this month's volunteer effort?
options: It matched every other month exactly.
It was the most productive month so far.
It was the least successful month on record.
It resulted in fewer meals than usual.
quests.correctAnswer: It was the most productive month so far.
quests.hint: Think about what 'higher than any previous month' tells you about this month's results.
quests.explanation: A meal count higher than any previous month shows this was the most productive month for the volunteer effort so far.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Sitting Apart] Two coworkers who used to eat lunch together every day now sit at opposite ends of the break room without speaking.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the coworkers' relationship?
options: They have become closer friends recently.
Something may have caused tension between them.
They have never spoken to each other before.
They still eat lunch together daily.
quests.correctAnswer: Something may have caused tension between them.
quests.hint: Compare their old lunch habit with how they are behaving now.
quests.explanation: A sudden change from eating together daily to sitting apart in silence suggests something has caused tension between the two coworkers.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Warnings in the Comments] The travel blog's comment section fills with warnings about long lines after visitors describe waiting over three hours to enter the popular exhibit.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the exhibit?
options: Visitors can walk in with no wait at all.
Visitors should expect a significant wait to get in.
The exhibit is rarely visited by tourists.
The exhibit has closed to the public.
quests.correctAnswer: Visitors should expect a significant wait to get in.
quests.hint: Think about what several similar warnings in the comments suggest about the typical experience.
quests.explanation: Multiple visitors mentioning three-hour waits suggests that long lines are a common part of visiting this exhibit.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Confusing Idiom] The translation app correctly handles Elena's simple questions but returns a confusing, garbled sentence when she tries to translate a complicated idiom.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the translation app's abilities?
options: It cannot translate anything correctly.
It handles idioms better than simple sentences.
It struggles with complex or idiomatic language.
It fails at every type of translation.
quests.correctAnswer: It struggles with complex or idiomatic language.
quests.hint: Compare how the app performs with simple questions versus the idiom.
quests.explanation: Handling simple questions well but failing on an idiom suggests the app is more capable with basic language than complex expressions.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [Triple the Downloads] The podcast episode about ocean exploration receives triple the usual number of downloads within its first day of release.
quests.question: What can be inferred about that episode's topic?
options: It performed exactly the same as other episodes.
It received far less interest than usual.
It was removed shortly after release.
It attracted more interest than the podcast's typical episodes.
quests.correctAnswer: It attracted more interest than the podcast's typical episodes.
quests.hint: Compare this episode's downloads with what is described as 'usual.'
quests.explanation: Triple the usual downloads in just one day suggests this particular episode drew unusually strong interest from listeners.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [The Same Potato Salad] Every relative brings a different homemade dish to the reunion, but this year, three separate people arrive with the exact same potato salad recipe.
quests.question: What can be inferred about the potato salad recipe?
options: It is likely a well-known family favorite.
Only one person knows how to make it.
It is a recipe nobody in the family likes.
It was invented for the first time this year.
quests.correctAnswer: It is likely a well-known family favorite.
quests.hint: Think about why three different relatives would independently choose the same recipe.
quests.explanation: Three relatives independently bringing the same recipe suggests it holds a special, well-loved place within the family.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Long Hold] The customer service line puts Mr. Yilmaz on hold for over forty minutes, and the automated message keeps repeating that his call is 'very important.'
quests.question: What can be inferred about the company's call volume?
options: It answers every call within seconds.
It is likely receiving more calls than it can handle quickly.
It has no customers calling in at all.
It is receiving very few calls today.
quests.correctAnswer: It is likely receiving more calls than it can handle quickly.
quests.hint: Think about what a long hold time combined with a repeating message suggests about how busy the lines are.
quests.explanation: A forty-minute wait with a repeating 'important call' message suggests the company is dealing with more calls than it can answer promptly.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct inference.
quests.passage: [A Familiar Driver] The same delivery driver has dropped off packages at Mrs. Kowalski's door every afternoon this week, always waving before driving off.
quests.question: What can be inferred about Mrs. Kowalski and the driver?
options: They have never met before this week.
She has stopped receiving packages entirely.
They have become somewhat familiar with each other.
The driver refuses to acknowledge her.
quests.correctAnswer: They have become somewhat familiar with each other.
quests.hint: Think about what a friendly wave, repeated all week, suggests about their growing familiarity.
quests.explanation: A friendly wave every day for a week suggests the driver and Mrs. Kowalski have become familiar with one another through repeated visits.
